subject: Clarification on presentation timing request
text:
Hi all,

I want to clarify the request I made this morning about the group presentation schedule. When I asked for possible time slots, I did not mean that we should choose the next available opening. I meant that we need to confirm whether the Tuesday evening room is still reserved for our presentation and, if it is not, find a time before the project checkpoint on Friday.

The reason I am asking again is that the change is now time-sensitive. The campus events office emailed me shortly before class and said they are reviewing the room assignments for the week. If our presentation is not listed by the end of the day, the slot may be released to another group. That could force us to present at the last minute or ask for an exception.

To avoid confusion, please do not assume the Wednesday morning option works unless everyone agrees. I only mentioned it as a backup after checking the shared calendar. What I need from you today is a clear yes or no for the Tuesday evening slot, and one alternative you can keep open until Thursday. If anyone has a conflict, state it now rather than later.

That will help me avoid sending another message after the office closes.

Please reply in the group thread rather than to me individually, so the information stays in one place. If anyone has already emailed the events office, let me know as soon as possible.
